content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using [product_name] [version_no] along with [product_name] [product_name]. My external text display does not match the counter values shown on the main [product_name] display, even though the textblock should show identical information on both displays. Please check the picture (IMG_1129) and the attached program ([document]). Note the discrepancies in counter values between the main and external displays: [product_name] [product_name]: 24 0counter block B001 24 20counter block B257 24 24calculator block B213 I've discovered that if the counter value is used in another block, such as calculator block B213, the value displays correctly. I use [product_name] [article_no] E stand 04 and [product_name] [article_no] E stand 08. What could be causing this? Thanks, [user_name]
There is no attachment included. Regards,
Hello, I've now attached two files. Thanks, [user_name]

Hi, I'm not certain about the cause of the issue. The project was made using [product_name] [version_no]; perhaps there is a problem in part of the program. It's also possible that the function block number is affecting the results. As a reference, I copied and pasted your function blocks into a new section, and that segment operates as expected. Hope this information is helpful.

I'm facing the same issue. I believe this is an incompatibility between [product_name] and the text display. Try setting counter block numbers below 128; all blocks referenced in "message text" must use numbers lower than B128. This solution worked for me.
Hello, Are you using [product_name] [article_no] E stand 08 or an earlier version? Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users report inconsistent counter values between the primary [product_name] display and its associated external text display. The issue appears connected to the numbering of counter blocks, especially those above B128, and potential incompatibilities between [product_name] and text display versions. There is ongoing confusion due to unclear documentation regarding version compatibility and addressing limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that counter values shown on the external text display will match those of the main [product_name] display regardless of block numbering. They seek reliable, documented behavior across all compatible [product_name] and text display versions.
